here is a sheet for heretic: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1unU5LcivK\_lO-y5xB8U6rWd2JxbuS99zdKEYNQLp7Us/edit?gid=1378658536#gid=1378658536](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1unU5LcivK_lO-y5xB8U6rWd2JxbuS99zdKEYNQLp7Us/edit?gid=1378658536#gid=1378658536)

as for lvling - currently, the best way is to get carried by 250lvl friend (or kingdom mate), who will run endless and will share exp with you. once you hit 245, you can go for 1turn ultima build and do endless on your own.

if you dont want to get carried, raids are your best bet. 

you can also check, if you have items for summoner and do endless yourself - yelmongus gear is now available, so it should not be that hard. here is a guide for summoners - go to endless section: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx\_pGWp6MxrEq\_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?gid=1899425289#gid=1899425289](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JDNee0miAjx_pGWp6MxrEq_e7NnmJsbS11x60brE4sw/edit?gid=1899425289#gid=1899425289)
